newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HJ Joel March qtr pre-capex net flat.
newsitem.headline: HJ Joel March qtr pre-capex net flat.

text.p: Quarter to end-March versus preceding quarter
Full name: HJ Joel Gold Mining Company Ltd, managed by JCI Ltd.
NOTE - The company said that good progress had been made at No.1 shaft during the quarter, and the programme is on schedule with full scale sinking expected to start during May 1997.

The company said that in view of the tonnage build-up it has been decided to accelerate the capex programme to provide for a milling capacity of 150,000 tonnes per month which will be attained soon after the planned commissioning of the new shaft system on July 1, 2001.

Before final shaft commissioning, the milling rate will have been increased to 110,000 tonnes per month (July 1997) and 130,000 tonnes per month (July 1998) by completing plant modifications and making further logistical changes.
The company said that full calendar operations were in place with current levels of production expected to be maintained in the current quarter.
